title: Cooking Buttery Flaky Croissants in Infinite Kitchen, updated cooking system is live
author: VirtualJamesHarrison
selftext:
Far smarter AI cooking mode with many more base ingredients and tools.   
Cooking should now feel far more realistic and predictable   
  
[https://infinite-kitchen.com/kitchen](https://infinite-kitchen.com/kitchen)

comments.author: ultimate_doofus
comments.body: I love this, but why did you switch it to desktop only? I feel like allowing mobile will help you keep a larger number of users.

replies.author: VirtualJamesHarrison
replies.body: With more tools and ingredients now the UI sucks on mobile. But I am working on a solution.

replies.author: According_Picture294
replies.body: Yeah. I noticed that when I used mobile mode too

replies.author: VirtualJamesHarrison
replies.body: Big updating coming tomorrow that should fix all.

replies.body: I had to make a rules update to tell people to stop posting "When update happen" posts
